items.claim: Validation messages should be shown next to the related field, and user input should be preserved when validation fails.
items.snippet: Show each validation message next to the field it relates to, and keep everything the user entered when validation fails.

items.claim: An error state should not rely on colour alone and should include text naming the problem.
items.snippet: Do not rely on colour alone to show that a field has an error; include text that names the problem.

items.claim: Required fields should be validated before submission and validated again on the server, because client-side checks can be bypassed.
items.snippet: Validate required fields before submission and validate again on the server, because client-side checks can be bypassed.

items.claim: An audit record for an approval decision should capture who acted, what was decided, when it happened, and the state before and after the change.
items.snippet: An audit record for an approval decision should capture who acted, what was decided, when it happened, and the state before and after the change.

items.claim: Audit records should be append-only so that later edits cannot rewrite history.
items.snippet: Audit records should be append-only so that later edits cannot rewrite history.

items.claim: Retention periods for audit records are set by the organisation's policy rather than by the user interface.
items.snippet: Retention periods for audit records are set by the organisation's policy, not by the user interface.
